job_no.description: producer's snapshot of the job number (duplicates the subject spine's canonical key)

lesson_candidates.description: candidate lessons awaiting human promotion; empty array is valid

lesson_candidates[].cause.description: attributed cause, one of the five code-defined values in, `:86-131`

lesson_candidates[].promotion_gate.description: explicit "candidate only, human sign-off required" marker

lesson_candidates[].provenance.drift_dol.description: points scaled by contract value; null when no contract value

lesson_candidates[].provenance.evidence.description: the observed signal behind the cause (e.g. a diary-flag count)

lesson_candidates[].provenance.month.description: claim-cycle month the drift is measured in

lesson_candidates[].statement.description: the candidate lesson, stated as cause + drift + period + project

margin_to_date_pct.description: margin to date at attribution time

observability_gaps_ranked.description: data gaps that made a cycle unattributable, ranked; empty array valid

observability_gaps_ranked[].gap.description: the named missing data (e.g. no diaries for a month)

observability_gaps_ranked[].margin_point.description: total absolute drift the gap obscures

observability_gaps_ranked[].months.description: the months in which that gap occurred

project_name.description: producer's snapshot of the project/client label (duplicates the entity label)

subject_entity_id.description: the project the learning is about; the semantic fact's subject and its supersede key

summary.description: one-line human summary for content search and list display
